time periods (March 2020 to December 2020, January 2021 to April 2021, May 2021 to November 2021)
Robson Ten Group Classification System of deliveries
cohort: 457 pregnant women with a diagnosis of COVID-19
finding: The overall cesarean section rate significantly decreased over time from period 1 to period 3, particularly in Robson category 1 and Robson category 3, while the incidence of induction of labor significantly increased over time.
mod_finding: This study observed a decrease in the rate of Cesarean section (CS) in pregnant women with COVID-19 over time.
